steps.message: What was the longest distance covered in a mountain biking activity in the OpenTracks app this week? Assume the week starts from Monday. Express your answer as a single number in meters rounded to the nearest integer.
Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i opentracks"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i opentracks""
python android_env.py adb "adb shell "find /data/data -type d -name '*opentracks*' 2>/dev/null | head -5""
